name: Contrast
definition: Two adjacent elements differ in value, hue, texture, size or shape. Contrast marks edges and makes the focal point.

measures.measure: light reflectance value difference between adjacent planes
measures.reference: 30 or more for a visible edge

measures.measure: brightest mass to deepest shadow in one image
measures.reference: 3–4 flat; 5–8 hard, 8 or more for expressionist

sources.title: Donis A. Dondis, A Primer of Visual Literacy (MIT Press, 1973)
